credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Secrets such as `password`. Stored encrypted, never returned.

AccountFailure.title: AccountFailure
AccountFailure.description: An account that could not answer, in a list across accounts.

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: One way to connect an address, as found by one source.

CredentialInfo.title: CredentialInfo
CredentialInfo.description: That a credential is stored, never its value.

CredentialKind.title: CredentialKind
CredentialKind.description: What to ask the person for.

Discovery.title: Discovery
Discovery.description: Ranked ways to connect an address, best first.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error the API raises itself.

subscribed.title: Subscribed
subscribed.description: Whether the folder is subscribed on the server (IMAP). Mail clients such as Outlook show only subscribed folders, and the inbox always. Null where the provider has no subscriptions.

FolderRole.title: FolderRole
FolderRole.description: Special-use role, after RFC 6154 and JMAP.

Grant.title: Grant
Grant.description: Rights on accounts: operation or group names, account ids or ``*``.

Hint.title: Hint
Hint.description: Something the person has to know or do, with a help page if known.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Account id to the operations allowed on it

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: Operations not bound to one existing account

Me.title: Me
Me.description: The caller and its effective rights.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Further flags, named as in JMAP: `$answered`, `$forwarded`, `$draft`, and the provider's own keywords.

MessagePage.title: MessagePage
MessagePage.description:
Messages across accounts. ``incomplete`` names the accounts that did
not answer; their messages are missing from this page.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Further flags, named as in JMAP: `$answered`, `$forwarded`, `$draft`, and the provider's own keywords.

folder_ids.title: Folder Ids
folder_ids.description: The folders the message is to be in. A change moves it; the id stays. An IMAP message is in exactly one folder.

MessageUpdate.title: MessageUpdate
MessageUpdate.description: What ``PATCH`` changes on a message. Fields left out stay as they are.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Group name to the operations it allows

Role.title: Role
Role.description: A named, reusable set of grants.

Security.title: Security
Security.description: Encryption of a mail server connection. Plain text is never offered.

token.title: Token
token.description: The token itself. Shown this once only.

User.title: User
User.description: Someone or something that calls the API.
